BMW Australian PGA Championship: Cameron Smith in contention in his first DP World Tour event since LIV Golf collapse
Cameron Smith's eight-under second round has put him into contention; it is Australian's first event since LIV golf's demise; watch the BMW Australia PGA Championship throughout the week on Sky Sports Golf
Friday 27 November 2026 08:17, UK
Former Open champion Cameron Smith roared into contention in his first DP World Tour event since the collapse of LIV Golf with a second round eight-under par in Sydney.
Smith is playing in the Tour under a specific agreement, but made a slow start on day one of the BMW Australian PGA Championship with an opening round 71.
However, an eagle at the 14th by the 33-year-old in his second round helped him reach nine-under at the halfway mark to sit four off leader Nicolai von Dellingshausen ahead of the weekend.
Two birdies in the first three holes ensured Smith made a strong start and he got through his front nine at four-under.
A bogey at the 10th provided a setback, but the 2022 Open champion regrouped to get the shot back at the 11th before a superb approach helped Smith set up an eagle opportunity.
After he landed the eagle on the 14th, birdies on the 16th and 17th wrapped up a fine round of 64.
"It's only Friday, so we've still got a couple days to go, but it's nice to play the weekend," Smith said.
"It's nice to be in a position where I can compete and that's where I need to be to make my game better is competing and being under the pump a little bit. I kind of got in a bit of a groove and a bit of a rhythm today."
Northern Irishman Tom McKibbin is one shot ahead of Smith on 10-under after he hit 65 at The Lakes Golf Club on Friday.
Von Dellingshausen matched Smith with 64 to hold a three-shot lead on 13-under, but almost produced a hole-in-one at the 15th.
Later in the day, Robbie Minns did claim a hole-in-one with a seven iron at the 18th to win a BMW X5 40i.
Three players are tied for fourth on seven-under and England's Sam Bairstow is joint 18th on four-under after a second round score of 69.

digest_he:
קמרון סמית' חזר להתחרות במסגרת סבב DP World Tour לראשונה מאז קריסת LIV Golf, ורשם הופעה מרשימה באליפות אוסטרליה ב-BMW. לאחר פתיחה איטית ביום הראשון עם תוצאה של 71 חבטות, האוסטרלי התאושש בגדול בסיבוב השני עם סיבוב מצוין של 64 חבטות שהעלה אותו למקום התשיעי מתחת לתקן.

סמית' ביצע איגל מרשים בחתך של החור ה-14 והוסיף מספר ציפורים שהביאו אותו לתוצאה מבטיחה לקראת סוף השבוע, כשהוא רחוק ארבע חבטות בלבד מהמוביל ניקולאי פון דלינגשאוזן. סמית' ציין כי הוא נהנה לחזור ולהיות תחת לחץ תחרותי שמסייע לו לשפר את משחקו, כאשר שחקנים נוספים כמו טום מקיבין ונורת' אייריש מתחרים גם הם בצמרת הטורניר.
